time_basis: Sunday, off-peak; check observed request timestamps. Flash aliases have the same published tariff; use response model and actual cached-input receipts.
assumptions: Main illustration uses Exa Auto Search at $0.007 and one text Contents at $0.001 per successful logical tool invocation. Official current MCP source accepts plain Bearer API keys, defaults search to auto absent override, and fetches /contents text. Hosted deployment/default environment and account bills are not exposed; this is an inference, not an invoice.
Exa Instant ($0.004) and zero marginal web charge under free credits are sensitivity cases, not claims about this account. Search summaries/highlights are not counted as independent full reads.

Tavily basic PAYG at $0.008 per credit. Basic Extract pricing is one credit per five successes; proportional vs one-credit-per-request rounding sensitivity. Free plans, keyless limits, subscriptions and grants not known.
DeepSeek direct Search/Fetch successful nonempty tariff applies; the temporary free period for server-hosted tools in named coding products is not assumed for our direct standalone HTTP requests.
Transport/local format failures can hide upstream successful processing; uncertain charged attempts shown separately and never declared free solely because local status failed.

Account before/after balance is net movement in a namespace, may include outside usage and billing lag, does not identify accounts or per-job invoices. Equal starting/ending balances across different keys are not added as separate accounts.
Full raw balances remain in ignored output; only deltas are public. No exchange-rate conversion between CNY model balances and USD web estimates.
